verdict.rationale: Bento has saved segments with a custom segment builder, an MCP server and CLI agents can drive, and a broadcasts API that takes explicit audience rules such as tag inclusion and exclusion. Subscriber search also accepts tag, segment and date filters. So an agent can approximate a described audience through tag-based targeting and filtered search, but nothing shows the MCP, CLI or API creating a saved segment. The plain-text AI builder is not tied to segments or to a programmatic surface. Missing for 10: a documented segment-creation endpoint or MCP/CLI tool, evidence that an agent can turn a natural-language audience description into a saved segment, and hands-on corroboration.
